messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — we need a top-off for eu-west capacity. Planning to add 24x A100 80GB to the pool. Can procurement confirm lead time and the vendor swap/war‑ranty flow for ~3–5 DOA units?
Mina P: Talking to GigaTech now. Preliminary lead time is 6–8 weeks, but they can do a 2‑week air top-off at +22% on unit cost if we accept cross-ship. Want to know if ops can accept staggered arrivals.
Sophie O: Staggered is OK if we get serials in advance and a crosswalk to stage provisioning. Ideally all units onboarded inside 48h of arrival to avoid scheduler churn.
Mina P: Dom — can you confirm GigaTech's on‑warranty advance replacement policy (credit vs cross-ship) and whether they provide pre-paid RMA labels inside EU? Also need HS code for tariff estimation.
Dom (GigaTech): We can do advance cross-ship for warranty swaps inside EU (FRA hub). Policy: cross-ship for first 7 days, then RMA return required. Pre-paid labels included for EU shipments. HS code: 8471.80; will include on manifest.
Carla F: Pricing check — if we take the 2‑week expedite air option (+22%), what's the landed cost per unit (inc duty & VAT)? Finance needs an estimate to approve. Also need payment terms if we move to reserved capacity.
Dom (GigaTech): Approx landed: $22.5k/unit (list $18.5k, expedite premium, est VAT/duty ~11%). For reserve monthly commitments we can discount 6% once commit >48 units/quarter.
Alex K: Noted. Sophie — can you map these 24 units to our existing allocation plan and confirm buffer sizing? We want 8 units as hot buffer, 16 in scheduled ramp.
Sophie O: Will update allocation sheet. Quick Q: do we need manifest with serial pairing so we can pre-seed hosts with device IDs? That avoids waiting for post-RMA inventory reconciliation.
Mina P: Yes — require full serial crosswalk + shipping AWB so eng can pre-seed. Dom, can GigaTech share a CSV manifest that matches our template?
Dom (GigaTech): Can do. Sample below — we will fill with real serials once final PO is out.
carrier-bot: AWB provisional created: GTX-EU-763412345.ETA:FRA:2024-06-12T09:00Z. Tracking URL: https://carrier.example/GTX-EU-763412345
Alex K: Perfect. Put manifest in the same thread when ready. Also: can we get a commitment for 24h turn on for cross-ship units once they clear the FRA hub? Ops will do local imaging + burn-in.
Dom (GigaTech): 24h SLA for cross-ship activation acknowledged. Will include expedited customs clearance paperwork for FRA port.
Carla F: Two more asks: 1) For DOA credits, do you net against future invoices or issue a refund? 2) Are there any restocking fees on returns after 30 days? We want clear accounting.
Dom (GigaTech): DOA credit policy: credit on next invoice or direct refund on request (takes 7–10 business days). No restocking fee for warranty returns inside 60 days; after 60 days 5% restock.
Sophie O: Ops note — please avoid mixing different firmware batches in the same rack unless we can stage a coordinated firmware flash. Need batch IDs on manifest.
Dom (GigaTech): Will include firmware/batch metadata column in CSV. Sample header below:
```
serial,sku,firmware_build,shipment_type,awb,anticipated_arrival,hs_code
GTX1234567890,A100-80GB,fw-3.1,cross-ship,GTX-EU-763412345,2024-06-12T09:00Z,8471.80
```
Mina P: I'll push PO today with expedite clause conditional on the 24h activation SLA and pre-shared manifest. Carla — accept estimate to proceed?
Carla F: Approve provisional cost for expedite option pending final landed invoice. Please include duty/VAT reconciliation in final billing.
Alex K: One more operational constraint — eu-west cluster has IB switch maintenance 2024-06-14 to 2024-06-15. Can we avoid scheduling large host activations during that window? Dom, please target arrival outside that maintenance window or hold at FRA for later delivery if needed.
Dom (GigaTech): Noted. We can shift last-mile to 2024-06-11 or hold until 2024-06-16. Will flag carrier.
Sophie O: I'll update the provisioning timeline and send a short runbook for staging imaging + burn-in (30–48h).
Alex K: Thanks all. Action items: Mina — finalize PO and manifest; Dom — provide filled CSV + confirm final AWB; Sophie — update allocation & runbook; Carla — finalize provisional payment. Ping here when manifest is uploaded. :thumbsup:
